segments.speaker: Hila Gonen
segments.text: Yeah. And so what we do in that paper is we look at specific knowledge that the model possesses according to some definition. segments.speaker: Hila Gonen

segments.text: Yeah, so what we did in that paper is essentially identifying layers within the model. I'll talk about cross-linguality.
